questions.question: Where do exports run?
questions.default: In the web process, behind a 30-second timeout

options.consequence: nothing new to deploy, but an export of more than about 10,000 widgets times out.
no timeout and retries for free, but it waits for `export-worker`.
no server cost, but every client needs its own exporter.
opens in any spreadsheet; nested fields are flattened.
keeps nested fields, but most owners need a converter to read it.

questions.question: Which queue? Options: the database table (no new service); a hosted queue (needs an account).
How long does a finished export stay downloadable?

options.consequence: the least storage, but an owner who exports on a Friday has lost it by Monday.
covers a weekend and a holiday, and storage grows by about a week of exports.
never lost, but storage grows without bound and needs its own clean-up job.

questions.question: Does a retried export keep its `id | attempt` key, answered as `Q3 → <option>`?

options.consequence: retries are idempotent, so a crash mid-export never writes a row twice.
simpler keys, but a retry can write a second copy.
